title: Victor Roy, a Masonic Poem
author: Harriet Annie Wilkins

authorInfo.bio: Harriet Annie Wilkins (1829–1888) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Victor Roy: A Masonic Poem" by Harriett Annie Wilkins is a poetic narrative composed in the late 19th century. The work encapsulates a story that intertwines themes of loss, faith, and human resilience against the backdrop of Masonic symbolism.
